Rule.Title: MISSION TACTICS
Rule.Text:
Friendly KILL TEAM units with this ability have the following abilities:
Furor Tactics
When the enemy horde grows close, the Deathwatch will be tasked with the decimation of their core. Aiming not for clinical kills but for maximum destruction over a wide area, they tear the heart from the enemy army.If the devastator doctrine is active for your unit, your unit’s attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].
Malleus Tactics
When the giants of war lumber forth, the Deathwatch will adopt Malleus tactics. Even the largest behemoth has a weak point, and the archives of the Deathwatch number them all.If the tactical doctrine is active for your unit, your unit’s attacks have [LETHAL HITS].
Purgatus Tactics
By adopting Purgatus tactics, the Deathwatch focus their deadly ire upon the commanders of the enemy host, assassinating them one after another with pitiless head shots and killing thrusts of the blade.If the assault doctrine is active for your unit, your unit’s attacks that target an enemy unit within 9" of this unit have [PRECISION].
DEATHWATCH ALLIES
You can include Deathwatch units in your army, even though they do not have the same Chapter faction keyword as other units in your army. The combined points value of such units cannot exceed 500 points.
When mustering your army, unless otherwise stated, you cannot select a Deathwatch model to be your Warlord. In addition Kill Team units can only contain enhancements taken from this detachment.
This an exception to the Space Marine Chapters Army Rules.

Rule.Title: INDOMITABLE DEFENCE
Rule.Text: While a friendly Gravis unit is within range of an objective, attacks that target that unit with a S greater than that unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.

Enhancements.Description: Gravis unit only. This unit has +1 OC.

Enhancements.Name: Narthecis Gauntlet
Enhancements.Description: Apothecary Biologis model only. in your Command phase, this unit heals D3+1 wounds.

Stratagems.Name: Adamantine Terror
Stratagems.When: Start of the Fight phase.
Stratagems.Effect: Each enemy unit engaged with your unit makes a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll.

Stratagems.Name: Upstoppable Advance
Stratagems.When: Your Movement/Charge phase, when a friendly Dreadnought unit is selected to move or declares a charge.
Stratagems.Effect: Your unit has Mobile.

Stratagems.When: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly Dreadnought unit is selected to attack.
Stratagems.Effect:
Your unit’s attacks have:
[lethal hits]. Or: [Sustained Hits 1].

Rule.Title: ENDURING VENGEANCE
Rule.Text: Friendly Adeptus Astartes Dreadnought units can re-roll hit rolls of 1.

Enhancements.Description: Dreadnought unit only. Attacks that target this unit have -1 D.

Enhancements.Description: Dreadnought unit only. While a friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry/Mounted unit is within 6" of this unit, that unit’s attacks can re-roll hit rolls of 1.

Rule.Title: IRONSTORM AUTO-TARGETERS
Rule.Text:
Friendly Adeptus Astartes Vehicle units’ (excluding walker units) ranged attacks can:
▪ Re-roll one hit roll.
▪ Re-roll one wound roll.

Stratagems.Name: Might Of The Machine Spirit
Stratagems.When: Your Command phase.
Stratagems.Target: One friendly Adeptus Astartes Vehicle unit (excluding Dedicated Transport/Fly/Walker units).
Stratagems.Effect:
Until the start of your next Command phase, your unit can ignore modifiers to your unit’s:
M. BS. Hit rolls and wound rolls.

Stratagems.Effect: Your unit has Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds.

Stratagems.Effect: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [Lethal Hits: Monster/Vehicle].

Enhancements.Name: Gunnery Honours (Upgrade)
Enhancements.Description: Adeptus Astartes Vehicle unit only (excluding Dedicated Transport/Fly/Walker units). This unit’s ranged attacks have [Heavy].

Enhancements.Name: Redoubtable Machine Spirit (Upgrade)
Enhancements.Description:
Adeptus Astartes Vehicle unit only (excluding Dedicated Transport/Fly/Walker units). This unit:
Has 5+ InSv. At the end of your Command phase, heals 1 wound.

Stratagems.Name: Vengeful Animus

+1" M. +1 T. +1 Ld. +1 OC. +1 to hit rolls.

Stratagems.Target: One friendly Adeptus Astartes unit that is below starting strength.
Stratagems.Effect:
Until the start of your next Command phase, your unit can ignore modifiers to your unit’s:
BS and WS. Hit rolls and Wound rolls.

Stratagems.Name: Power Of The Machine Spirit
Stratagems.When: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly unengaged Adeptus Astartes Vehicle unit has shot.
Stratagems.Effect:
Your unit shoots using:
Snap shooting. Or: If your unit is at half-strength/below half-strength, normal shooting. While doing so your unit can only target that enemy unit.

Stratagems.Name: Methodical Brutality
Stratagems.When: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase when a friendly Adeptus Astartes unit is selected to attack.
Stratagems.Effect: If your unit is a Vehicle unit, have +1 to wound rolls.

Rule.Title: ARMOURED WRATH
Rule.Text:
Each time a friendly Adeptus Astartes unit is selected to shoot or selected to fight apply one of the following when resolving those attacks:
▪ If that unit is within 6" of a friendly Cannok Var/Iron Father Feirros unit you can:
▪ Re-roll one hit roll.
▪ Re-roll one wound roll.
▪ Re-roll one damage roll.
▪ Otherwise you can:
▪ Re-roll one hit roll.
▪ Or: Re-roll one wound roll.
▪ Or: Re-roll one damage roll.

Enhancements.Name: Adept of the Omnissiah
Enhancements.Description: TECHMARINE model only. (Once per battle round, per army) When an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit within 6" of this unit, you can use this ability. If you do, that Vehicle unit has Feel No Pain 5+ until that enemy unit has attacked.

Enhancements.Name: Master of the Machine War
Enhancements.Description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. In your Movement phase, you can select one visible friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit within 6” of this model and then select the devastator doctrine or tactical doctrine. That doctrine is active for that VEHICLE unit until the start of your next Command phase.

Enhancements.Name: Target Augury Web
Enhancements.Description: TECHMARINE model only. In your movement phase, at the start or end of this unit’s move, you can select one friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE model within 3" of this unit. That Vehicle model’s attacks have [LETHAL HITS] until the start of your next Command phase

Enhancements.Name: The Flesh is Weak
Enhancements.Description:
Adeptus Astartes model only. This model:
Has +1 T. Has Feel No Pain 5+.

Stratagems.When: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
Stratagems.Target: One friendly unengaged Phobos/Scout Squad unit.
Stratagems.Effect: Place your unit in strategic reserves.

Stratagems.Name: Mortis Snares
Stratagems.When: End of your Movement phase.
Stratagems.Target: One friendly unengaged Phobos/Scout Squad unit.
Stratagems.Effect:
If your unit is controlling an objective, that objective is snared. While an objective is snared, when an enemy unit ends a move within range of that objective, roll one D6:
On a 2+, that enemy unit suffers D6 mortal wounds. That objective is no longer snared.

Stratagems.Name: Strike From The Shadows

Stratagems.Effect:
Your unit’s attacks have:
+1 S. [Lethal Hits].

Rule.Text:
When a friendly Phobos or Scout SQUAD unit has shot:

Enhancements.Name: Venator Omni-auspex
Enhancements.Description:
Phobos model only. This unit’s attacks that target a hidden unit can:
Re-roll wound rolls of 1. Or: If the assault doctrine is active for this unit, re-roll wound rolls of 1 and 2.

Stratagems.When: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly hidden Phobos unit is selected to attack.
Stratagems.Effect:

+1 S. [Lethal Hits].

Stratagems.When: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged Phobos unit.
Stratagems.Effect:
Your unit can make a normal move of:
Up to D6". Or: If the tactical doctrine is active for your unit, up to 6".

Stratagems.Effect: Ranged attacks that target your unit have -1 to hit rolls.

Enhancements.Name: Venator Omni-auspex
Enhancements.Description:

Re-roll wound rolls of 1. Or: If the assault doctrine is active for this unit, re-roll wound rolls of 1-2.

Rule.Title: LIGHTNING-FAST STRIKE
Rule.Text: Friendly Adeptus Astartes Mounted/Speeder units have +2" M.

Enhancements.Description: Adeptus Astartes Mounted unit only. This unit can re-roll advance rolls.

Stratagems.Effect: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

Stratagems.Name: Domination Fire

Select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. That enemy unit is suppressed until the start of your next turn:
While a unit is suppressed, that unit’s attacks have -1 to hit rolls.

Stratagems.Name: Masterful Tactics
Stratagems.When: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged Adeptus Astartes Infantry/Mounted unit.
Stratagems.Effect:
Your unit can make a normal move of:
Up to D6". Or: If the tactical doctrine is active for your unit, up to 6".

Enhancements.Description: Adeptus Astartes model only.(Once per battle round, per army) When you use the Fire Overwatch/Heroic Intervention stratagem, if you target a friendly Adeptus Astartes Battleline unit within 12" of this model with that stratagem, that use is -1 CP.

ArmyRules.Title: COMBAT DOCTRINES
ArmyRules.Text:
At the start of your Command phase, you can select one combat doctrine listed below. If you do, that combat doctrine is active for friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units with this ability until the start of your next Command phase.
▪ ASSAULT DOCTRINE: When this unit is selected to make an advance move, that advance move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to declare a charge.
▪ DEVASTATOR DOCTRINE: This unit’s ranged attacks have [ASSAULT].
▪ TACTICAL DOCTRINE: When this unit is selected to make a fall-back move, that fall-back move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to shoot and eligible to declare a charge.
Unless otherwise stated:
▪ You can only select each combat doctrine once per battle.
▪ Only one combat doctrine can be active for each unit. If a rule makes a combat doctrine active for a unit, any combat doctrine previously active for that unit is no longer active for that unit.

ArmyRules.Title: TRANSHUMAN STRATEGIST
ArmyRules.Text: At the start of the battle round, if a model with this ability is your WARLORD, gain 1CP.

ArmyRules.Title: LIBRARIUS
ArmyRules.Text:
ADEPTUS ASTARTES PSYKER units with this ability have a psyker level of 1 or higher, specified in that unit’s abilities. Each psychic ability has a psychic level of 1 or higher, specified in that ability’s name.
In a battle round, a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES PSYKER unit can use a number of psychic abilities whose total psychic level does not exceed that PSYKER unit’s psyker level.
Example: In a battle round, a psyker level 3 PSYKER unit could use three psychic level 1 abilities, or one psychic level 1 ability and one psychic level 2 ability, or one psychic level 3 ability.

ArmyRules.Title: SPACE MARINE CHAPTERS
ArmyRules.Text:
▪ If an Adeptus Astartes unit has a second Faction keyword on its datasheet, that Faction keyword is the name of that unit’s Chapter. For example, Marneus Calgar has both the Adeptus Astartes and Ultramarines Faction keywords, and is therefore from the Ultramarines Chapter.

	▪ You cannot include units from more than one Chapter in your army.

	▪ If your army includes one or more Black Templars units, it cannot include any Adeptus Astartes Psyker models, and cannot include any of the following models that do not have the Black Templars keyword: Gladiator Lancer; Gladiator Reaper; Gladiator Valiant; Impulsor; Repulsor; Repulsor Executioner.

	▪ If your army includes one or more Space Wolves units, it cannot include any of the following units: Apothecary; Devastator Squad; Tactical Squad.

Deathwatch
	▪ Your army can include Adeptus Astartes Deathwatch units, but it cannot include any Adeptus Astartes units drawn from any other Chapter.

	▪ With the exception of Kill Team Cassius (see Legends: Agents of the Imperium), your army cannot include any Agents of the Imperium Deathwatch units.

	▪ Your army cannot include any of the following units: Assault Squad; Assault Squad with Jump Packs; Attack Bike Squad; Devastator Squad; Land Speeder Storm; Relic Terminator Squad; Scout Bike Squad; Scout Squad; Scout Sniper Squad; Tactical Squad; Terminator Assault Squad; Terminator Squad.
